description.en: The DSH bundle for dsh-remedy: a patch set that repairs fused tool-call JSON at the stream seam and names the refusals it will not retry. This index pins the bundle to a git commit; the same package is also on npm as dsh-remedy, whichever a market prefers.
description.zh: dsh-remedy 的 DSH 插件包：在流接缝上修复粘连的工具调用 JSON，并命名它拒绝重试的那些失败类。此索引把插件钉在一个 git 提交上；同一个包也在 npm 上，市场用哪个都行。

description.en: Repairs fused tool-call arguments at the llm/stream seam and re-throws whatever it cannot prove, names the deterministic refusals it will not retry at agent/request-error, and answers per failure class which patch covers it and whether that patch is switched on here.
description.zh: 在 llm/stream 接缝上修复粘连的工具调用参数，证不出来的原样抛回；在 agent/request-error 上命名它不重试的确定性拒绝；并按失败类回答哪个补丁覆盖它、以及它在本 profile 里是否启用。

versions.note: the plugin pins dsh-remedy-core 0.3.8 exactly; installing it resolves both
